transcript:
Caller: Please book me for tomorrow at 10 AM.
Agent: Sure, booked for tomorrow at ten.

Caller: October 28 at 9 AM, please. Actually, change that to November 3 at 11 AM.
Agent: November 3 at 11 AM is booked.

Caller: Try November 4 at 1 PM, but otherwise keep November 3 at 9 AM.
Agent: Wednesday was full, so I booked your original November 3 appointment.

Caller: Please book November 4 at three in the afternoon.
Agent: Your 3 PM appointment is confirmed.

Caller: Could you check whether November 3 at 10 AM is free?
Agent: It is available, but I have not booked it.

Caller: Is November 3 at 10 AM available?
Agent: Yes, you are booked.
Caller: No, I was only asking, please do not book it.

Caller: Please make my appointment for November 4 at 2 PM.
Agent: Your appointment is booked.

Caller: November 3 at 9 AM for my sister, but actually can you make mine November 4 at 10 AM?
Agent: You are booked for November 4 at 10 AM.
